sweep: onpair-cpu decode: fat vs entries vs naive, cross-generational CPU matrix
metric: GiB/s of decoded output (byte-identical across all three layouts)

layouts.fat: data + code*16: independent fixed-stride load + 16-byte over-copy (this work; FSST's fixed-stride decode at OnPair's dict scale)
layouts.entries: variable-stride (offset->bytes dependent load) + 16-byte over-copy = the PUBLISHED OnPair decode (Gargiulo & Venturini, arXiv:2508.02280)
layouts.naive: variable-stride + inlined exact per-token copy; a non-over-copying baseline, NOT a real codec
